Market today: The mood in tech and chips is mixed. While innovation continues, new competition from players like OpenAI in custom AI chips could pressure margins for established giants. Geopolitical cyber threats also remain a backdrop.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -54.53% and highly leveraged. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also deeply in the red at -41.35%. SMH, your chip ETF, is down -12.86% and marked for trimming. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how the chip sector reacts to increased competition in custom AI silicon. Also, monitor overall market sentiment for tech, as your book is heavily concentrated.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially with new competitive pressures emerging in chips.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its deep -54.53% loss and leveraged decay, especially on margin.
Review SPAL, down -41.35% and leveraged; ensure its stop at 21.38 is respected to manage risk.
SMH is down -12.86% and marked TRIM; consider reducing exposure to manage chip sector headwinds.
